purpose: Teach: 目下/下車/一向に/終結/逸脱/釈放/破棄/自爆

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、目下の経済情勢を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you were writing about current economic conditions in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational check-in. Gentle curiosity with the confidence of someone who's actually read the work. Not testing—genuinely interested in what she chose.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、駅で下車した人々の動線を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on the flow patterns of people exiting the train station.
lines.style: Direct and clear, meeting her teacher's gaze steadily. A slight uptick in energy—she's ready to explain. No apology, just factual precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 物価が一向に下がらない構造を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Right, and you looked at the structural reasons prices haven't fallen, I remember.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle, almost reflective tone—like she's drawing a thread through what she's read. Not correcting, just affirming.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、冷戦の終結を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined how the end of the Cold War shaped those dynamics.
lines.style: Calm and factual. She's explained this before; she knows where she's going. A touch of quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家の規範からの逸脱を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you also addressed how politicians deviate from established norms—is that right?
lines.style: Steady, engaged tone. She's working through her memory of the thesis. Respectful interest, not interrogation. Open to what comes next.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、囚人の釈放制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I explored the psychology and policy around prisoner release and rehabilitation.
lines.style: Clear and purposeful. She's hitting the key points. A thread of sincerity underneath—this matters to her, and she wants to be understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国際条約の破棄を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: I see. You also touched on the dissolution of international treaties in that context.
lines.style: Reflective, connecting ideas aloud. Slower pace. She's not quizzing—she's thinking alongside Sakura. A note of genuine consideration.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、テロの自爆攻撃の心理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, and I examined the psychological factors underlying extreme forms of political violence.
lines.style: Steady and composed. She meets the serious topic head-on without flinching. Precise language, calm delivery. A moment of real intellectual honesty.
